verdict.rationale: Clara documents a REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 schema (confirmed by probe) and solid transaction-retrieval coverage, including billing-period pulls, update-date filters, and ERP-ID filtering. Credentials are self-managed as expiring dashboard projects, and the code examples use mTLS. The evidence never mentions OAuth flows or scoped tokens, and there are no API endpoints for expenses or receipts specifically. Missing for 10: documented OAuth authorization, permission-scoped tokens, receipt retrieval endpoints, expense-report API access, independent hands-on corroboration.
